nodes.label: Hero Fallback Image — Firefighters at Fire Scene
nodes.description: Dramatic action photograph showing multiple German firefighters (Feuerwehr) in full protective gear — dark navy turnout jackets with bright neon-yellow reflective stripes, yellow SCBA breathing apparatus cylinders on their backs, and white/yellow helmets — working amid smoke and debris at an active fire scene. The scene conveys urgency, professionalism, and teamwork. Color palette: dark navy, neon yellow-green, white smoke, grey rubble. Mood: intense, heroic, documentary. Used as the fallback/default background image for the hero section of the KFV Freising website.
